question: A treated water sample is reported as total coliform absent in a 100 mL portion. How is that result best read?
correctAnswer: It means no total coliform were detected in the portion tested

options: It proves every litre in the system is sterile
It shows the distribution system needs no further sampling this month or next
It means no total coliform were detected in the portion tested
It confirms the disinfectant residual was adequate that day
